visual_elements.description: Row 1 — Word sequence container: light-pink rectangle with dashed red border holding 8 white-pink rectangles with solid red borders and italic red labels: Word 0, Word 1, Word 2, Word 3, Word 4, Word 5, Word N-2, Word N-1. Between Word 5 and Word N-2 sits a horizontal ellipsis of 5 small gray dots.

Row 2 — Word Embedding container: very light green rectangle with dashed green border holding 8 green-outlined boxes. Each box contains a horizontal strip of 6 small cells — 5 light-yellow (#F5E6A3) plus 1 pink/magenta (#F2A7C3) cell containing a red italic symbol with subscript: X_0, X_1, X_2, X_3, X_4, X_5, X_{N-2}, X_{N-1}. Between the 6th and 7th box is an ellipsis of 5 small green dots.

Row 3 — Position Information container: light lavender rectangle with dashed blue border holding 8 blue-outlined boxes with italic blue labels: Pos 0, Pos 1, Pos 2, Pos 3, Pos 4, Pos 5, Pos N-2, Pos N-1. Blue-dot ellipsis (5 dots) between Pos 5 and Pos N-2. Exactly 3 small orange lightning-bolt icons sit beneath alternating boxes (under Pos 1, Pos 3, Pos 5). Directly below the container: six red '+δ' symbols — five spread under the Pos 0–Pos 5 region and one under Pos N-1 — indicating addition of position information.
Full-width dark-red banner rectangle with centered bold text: 'Combine' in yellow followed by 'Word Encoding and Position Information (for Each Word)' in white.

Row 4 — Final Embedding (I/P) container: light-pink rectangle with dashed red border holding 8 red-outlined rectangles with italic red labels: I/P 0, I/P 1, I/P 2, I/P 3, I/P 4, I/P 5, I/P N-2, I/P N-1. Empty pink gap (no dots) between I/P 5 and I/P N-2.

Four thick red block arrows: (1) from the Word Embedding row straight down into the banner at x≈64%; (2) from the Position Information row straight down into the banner at x≈74%; (3) from the banner straight down into the I/P row at x≈54%; (4) from the underbrace straight down to the blue caption at x≈54%.
visual_elements.position: vertical connectors between rows as listed

visual_elements.description: Large red curly brace rotated 90° to act as an underbrace, spanning nearly the full width beneath the I/P row, its point facing down toward the arrow and caption, grouping all I/P elements as one unit.

Bottom-left inset schematic inside a green-bordered rectangle: black text 'Positional Encoding' at top-left; a white circle containing a black sine-wave glyph; a small circle node with connector lines; a pink rectangle labeled 'Input Embedding' with a small orange lightning bolt on it; below it gray text 'inputs' with a black upward arrow into the pink box; lines convey the positional-encoding wave being added to the embedding. This is a miniature of the classic Transformer input block.
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with thin outline containing the number 20 in dark text, top-right corner.
